name: Main Character
source:
You are the Lucky Person who is given the chance to become a rich noble! You are given a mansion, land, money, and a personal maid to start your life with! However, you will quickly learn that things are not as easy as it seems when you're a noble...

[From [url=http://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/maid-with-perfection]official site[/url]]
